summary: Cliconf plugins abstract the CLI of network devices and give Ansible a standard interface to run tasks on them. They usually map one-to-one to platforms and are loaded automatically from ansible_network_os.
questions: How does Ansible know which CLI dialect to use for a switch?
Does each network platform have its own cliconf plugin?

answer_card.title: What cliconf plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Cliconf plugins wrap a network device's CLI in a standard interface for Ansible. They usually map one-to-one to device platforms, and Ansible picks the right one automatically from `ansible_network_os`.
